name: Savory Carrot Tart

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour, for rolling puff pastry

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim the carrots. Thaw the frozen puff pastry. Thinly slice the double cream Brie cheese. Beat the egg yolk.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.91 kg carrots, medium
1 sheet frozen puff pastry
226 g double cream Brie cheese
1 large egg yolk

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to lower third position; preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Slice 2 carrots crosswise into 1.5-cm-thick rounds; halve remaining carrots lengthwise.

On a rimmed baking sheet, toss all carrots with 1 tablespoon oil, 1 1/4 teaspoons salt, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, and 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger until evenly coated. Arrange carrot rounds and lengths in a single layer, cut side down. Roast until carrots are tender and lightly browned at edges, about 25 minutes. Let cool slightly, about 5 minutes; keep oven on.

While carrots are roasting, in a large bowl, thoroughly whisk vinegar, mustard, honey, remaining 1/2 teaspoon garlic, remaining 1/2 teaspoon ginger, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt. Drizzle in remaining 2 teaspoons oil while whisking constantly.

Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside. On a lightly floured work surface, use a rolling pin to roll puff pastry sheet into a 13- by 28-cm rectangle. Transfer to parchment-lined sheet. Using a pairing knife, lightly score a border around perimeter of puff pastry, about 1.5 cm from edges. Using a fork, prick pastry at 2.5-cm intervals inside the border (do not prick the border). Loosely cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to bake.

When ready to bake, arrange Brie slices in an even layer inside scored border of pastry. Arrange carrot rounds and lengths on top of cheese; drizzle and brush evenly with 2 tablespoons honey-mustard mixture. Lightly brush edges of pastry with beaten egg yolk.

Bake until cheese is melted and pastry is deeply browned on edges and crisp on bottom, 25 to 35 minutes. Transfer baking sheet to a wire rack and let cool 5 minutes. Transfer tart to cutting board and drizzle top with remaining honey-mustard mixture and garnish with black pepper and thyme leaves. Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

not_counted: All-purpose flour, for rolling puff pastry

schema_metadata.keywords: savory carrot tart, carrot tart recipe, vegetable tart

description: With little more than puff pastry, creamy Brie cheese, a few roasted carrots, and a zippy honey-mustard drizzle, this tart makes for an easy, colorful, and crowd-pleasing appetizer.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Freshly ground black pepper, for serving; Fresh thyme leaves, for serving

Make-ahead and storage: This tart is best served right after baking, but leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days. To reheat, transfer to a parchment paper–lined rimmed baking sheet, cover loosely with aluminum foil, and heat in a 175°C (350°F) oven until warmed through, cheese is softened, and puff pastry is recrisped.
author: Leah Colins
